Definition: a cord (as connecting), especially for measuring; figuratively, a rule; also a rim, a musical string or accord
BiblicalUsage: 1) cord, line, measuring-line; 1a) cord; 1b) measuring-line; 2) (BDB) onomatapoetic mimicry of Isaiah's words, perhaps senseless
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
